risks.risk: LED bulb may be damaged or have a poor output
risks.proof: A video showing the LED bulb being tested for brightness and flickering.

risks.risk: Rechargeable battery may be swollen or leaking
risks.proof: A photo of the battery with the manufacturer's identification sticker.

risks.risk: Head strap may be broken or loose
risks.proof: A photo of the head strap with the headlamp attached.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the battery powering the headlamp to test capacity.
Video of the LED bulb being tested for brightness.
Photo of the battery with the manufacturer's identification sticker.
response.reason: The item is a standard rechargeable headlamp. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-working/battery dead) until proof of function is provided.
